notes.title: Translation Update
notes.content:
This update introduces Russian and German translations, includes balance changes, and adds several quality of life improvements.

[h3]Additions[/h3][list][*]Added German translation[/*][*]Added Russian translation (thanks NikSynaly)[/*][*]Added icon for Exile next to graveyard icon (only shows when you have exiled creatures)[/*][*]Added "Quick Remove" button for lacrima (backpack icon that appears when clicking on an equipped lacrima)[/*][*]Added "Quick Equip" option when clicking on empty card slots[/*][*]Added "Clear Cards" button in inventory to quickly remove lacrima from all cards[/*][*]Added confirmation button for lacrima/blessing/card rewards[/*][*]Added new option to enable/disable confirmations (Options > General)[/*][*]Added new effect for card rewards (similar to lacrima rewards)[/*][*]Added card notificiation for whenever a status effect runs out or gets removed[/*][*]Added support for ultrawidescreen, 16:10, 4:3, and other resolutions
[/*][*]Card info is now shown when targeting a card with a spell[/*][/list]
[h3]Gameplay Adjustments[/h3][list][*]Adjusted boss fights: Chapter 1 and 2 boss fights always have 3 lanes, chapter 3 boss fight always has 5 lanes (thanks PersistentDreamer)[/*][*]Valefar: Changed "Steal Lacrima" to "Fracture"[/*][*]Amdusias: Removed "Magic Ward" from Chapter 1[/*][*]Demons now face up when spawned on enemy side during player's turn (i.e. after casting a spell)
[/*][*]Exhumed enemies no longer get revealed when they are exhumed during the attack phase (thanks Qwerty)[/*][*]Curses/Blessings can no longer get overcharged outside of combat (thanks Qwerty)[/*][*]Parasite now always starts with 2 on success; each success adds another 2[/*][*]Generated enemies no longer receive Heal if they already have Reinforced Shield / Magic Ward[/*][*]Gravedigger: Added 1 spell with Exhume to deck from the start (thanks Kool8987)[/*][*]Turned GlassCannon into a modifier (= purple lacrima)[/*][*]Reworked Deathblow: Deals damage equal to Bleed stacks and removes Bleed. Activation success: If 5 or more Bleed stacks got removed, destroy non-boss creature.[/*][*]TargetAll/Enemies/Allies effects now reduce lacrima values by 50% (thanks Arifmeticus)[/*][/list]
[h3]UI/UX Adjustments[/h3][list][*]Deckbound, Healingbound, Discardbound, and Despairbound now show relevant numbers in descriptions[/*][*]Removed "Mugged" trigger[/*][*]Added Button decorations to small "1-space" buttons (i.e. inventory arrows)[/*][*]Pressing left on lacrima in satchel always goes to cards (same for Altar of Tears)
[/*][*]Description for the "End turn" button is now always shown during first fight and whole first run[/*][*]Rest sequence now fades in/out instead of panning up/down (reduces motion sickness)[/*][*]Made shop music a bit quieter (thanks Pablo Murphy)[/*][/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3][list][*]Fixed softlock when playing a creature on another creature mid-chain reaction (thanks Micha, Qwerty)[/*][*]Fixed rare bug where a trigger would incorrectly turn into a modifier in Altar of Tears (thanks Qwerty)[/*][*]Fixed preview bug in Altar of Tears when moving active lacrima to inventory (thanks BrandMChaos)[/*][*]Fixed issue where active map node circle disappeared when clicking "Options" during Rest (thanks Qwerty)[/*][*]Fixed "Provoked" not triggering on immune bosses for offence lacrima actions (thanks Qwerty)[/*][*]Fixed despair icons (on cards in hand) not updating correctly when despair is reduced (thanks Qwerty)[/*][*]Fixed "Demon" not spawning correctly when placing a creature (thanks Qwerty)[/*][*]Fixed lacrima from Automaton not returning when Recycle was fractured (thanks Qwerty)[/*][*]Fixed lacrima activation ring stuck to cards without animation[/*][*]Fixed creature moving lanes during chain reactions returning incorrectly with 0 HP[/*][*]Fixed Turn Passed: Exodus situation where fight didn't properly end[/*][*]Fixed issue with status effects not appearing correctly in battle log[/*][/list]
Thanks for playing Faith in Despair.

tags.balance_change: -Bloodsucker deck has been changed (total revamp)
-Mercenary deck has been changed (replaced Capture with Recruit)
-Fight rewards no longer depend on enemy lacrima

-Reduced maximum despair from 67 to 58

-Replaced Capture with Exile: Exiles target non-boss creature

notes.title: Circles of Hell - Version 0.1.15
notes.content:
Version 0.1.15 introduces Circles of Hell, which are difficulty adjustments. More of them will be added in the future. With this change, the default game has been made slightly easier.

[list]
[*] Added Circles of Hell (selection appears after the first run)
[*] No more starter curse by default

[*] Right-click doesn't close end screen anymore (thanks NowOnTest)

[*] New cards are now drawn after enemy cards are revealed (to make OnShuffleDeck work after revealing cards) (thanks Syndel)
[*] Blessings selection screen now also shows card details on hover
[*] Added trigger "On Discard Card" (thanks Syndel)
[*] To address an issue with reloading a save file, I've now added a global exception handling (thanks NowOnTest)
[*] Fixed issue where card info was still displayed after leaving the end screen (thanks NowOnTest)
[*] Fixed calculation error with Burn on card with Magic Ward
[*] Fixed issue where sometimes after a fight you couldn't view blessings/curses (thanks Syndel)
[*] Fixed shops letting you sell more than one card if you didn't sell a card in previous shops (thanks Syndel)
[*] Fixed card arrow sometimes appearing misplaced
[/list]

Thank you for playing Faith in Despair.
